title: Agent Guard verification report
description: Written by agent-guard.sh pre-final --run-verify to .agents/state/last-verify-report.json (or AGENT_GUARD_VERIFY_REPORT_NAME), and by agent-guard.sh baseline to .agents/state/baseline-report.json (with baseline_key and toolchain). unverified means no command ran.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD at the start of the run; empty when there is none.

tier.description: pre-final's change-tier check, measured before the run and written with the report; absent when no tier is declared or the check was skipped.

task.description: Task id of the tier record; null when there is none.

allowed.description: The declared tier, or the suggested one when the user lowered it with a reason; null with no tier.

measured.description: Tier of the change since the task's base, by the same rules as tier suggest.

status.description: exceeded: on a result that is not stale, measured above allowed or missing_reviews not empty; a recommendation that never changes the exit code. A partial result says so (partial, and pre-final names the cause).

partial.description: The full change could not be measured (pre-final warns with the cause), or no tier is declared.

reason.description: The reason recorded with tier set --reason.

partial_reason.description: Why the measure is partial (null when it is not).

raised_after_coding.description: The declared tier is above coding_started_tier (the tier when a change other than *.md or *.mdx was first seen).

missing_reviews.description: After a raise: the reviews the new tier needs whose latest attempt does not pass. Also listed on a stale result; it makes the status exceeded only when the result is not stale.

budget_seconds.description: Total verification budget in seconds the run was given; 0 means unlimited.

baseline_key.description: Baseline only: SHA-256 of HEAD, the contract's verification[] and the toolchain fingerprint; an equal key, scope and clean tree reuse a pass, fail or unverified report.

toolchain.description: Baseline only: one fingerprint entry per toolchain[] command ("<command>\n<exit code, or timeout>\n<first 2 KB of output>"), or "undeclared" when the contract declares none.
